title: Alcove shelves with a lit shelf
summary: An alcove beside the chimney breast rebuilt with shelves, a lit shelf and a cupboard, all painted white.
intro: The alcove had a few old shelves on brackets. They came out and in went a proper unit: a low cupboard with two flat doors, open shelves above it, and a light in the shelf over the cupboard so it glows in the evening. The parts were painted before fitting, and the whole unit finished white to match the walls and the window shutters.

cover.alt: White painted alcove unit with open shelves above a low two-door cupboard, next to a sash window

steps.title: What was there
steps.text: Four shelves on brackets. Useful enough, but nothing hid the clutter and the bottom was wasted.

image.alt: Old shelves on brackets in the alcove, covered in tools

steps.title: Back to the wall
steps.text: Old shelves out and a new base set in so the unit sits level.

image.alt: The empty alcove with a new base fitted

steps.title: Painted first
steps.text: Doors and shelves painted on trestles in the room before they went in. It is far easier than painting inside the alcove.

image.alt: White painted shelves and doors laid out on trestles

gallery.alt: The shelf above the cupboard lit up, with the switch in hand
The alcove unit beside the folded window shutters
The unit seen from the window

poster.alt: 3D SketchUp model of the white alcove unit: a low two-door cupboard with four open shelves above and a lit shelf over the cupboard

model3d.title: The SketchUp model in 3D
model3d.text: The alcove unit drawn in SketchUp from the photos, at standard sizes rather than measured ones. Open the doors to see the shelf inside the cupboard, or take it apart board by board. The strip under the first shelf glows like the real light.
